longDescription: Claude 3.5 Sonnet (v2) was the most capable model from the Claude 3.5 generation, setting new benchmarks for coding, reasoning, and agentic tasks. It remains a popular choice for production applications requiring a proven, reliable model.

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import anthropic

client = anthropic.Anthropic()
message = client.messages.create(
    model="claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022",
    max_tokens=1024,
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)
print(message.content[0].text)
